_meta.status: CONTRACT FINAL — implementations landing today, shapes below are locked
_meta.backend_today: local TigerGraph Community Edition (Docker) — connection details will move to Savanna cloud once signup completes; only host/token change, tool names and shapes below do not
_meta.protocol: tigergraph-mcp (github.com/tigergraph/tigergraph-mcp) exposing these as callable MCP tools against graph `FraudGraph`
_meta.notes: All IDs are dataset-native strings (TransactionID as string, card_id like 'C01234-K1', customer_id like 'C01234', case_id). No invented IDs.

tools.name: get_account_subgraph
tools.description: Full local context for one card: the card, its owner, its transactions (most recent first, capped), the devices/email domains/billing regions those transactions touch, and any cards directly linked via shared device/email/region edges.

input.txn_limit: int, optional, default 100 — max transactions to return, most recent first

tools.name: find_fraud_ring
tools.description: Runs weakly-connected-components over the SHARES_DEVICE/SHARES_EMAIL/SHARES_ADDRESS backbone starting from a card, returns the connected cluster of cards plus which shared attributes tie them together.

input.min_shared_weight: number, optional, default 1 — filters weak single-signal links

tools.name: get_transaction_velocity
tools.description: Count and sum of transactions on a card within a rolling time window ending at a reference transaction (or now), for card-testing / burst detection.

input.reference_txn_id: string, optional — window ends at this txn's ts; defaults to latest txn on the card
input.amount_threshold: number, optional — if set, also returns count of txns below this amount (for card-testing's 'tiny authorizations' signal)

tools.name: get_prior_similar_cases
tools.description: Retrieves closed cases (ClosedCase vertices, our labeled memory) most similar to a given card/pattern, via shared device/region/email overlap first (structural), then embedding similarity over case narratives (semantic) as a fallback/re-rank.

input.pattern: string, optional — one of the five known patterns, or 'undocumented'
input.query_text: string, optional — free text for embedding similarity (e.g. a draft evidence summary)

similar_cases.match_reason: string — e.g. 'shared device profile' or 'embedding similarity 0.87'

tools.name: get_policy_context
tools.description: Structured retrieval of fraud policy rules and typology descriptions relevant to a topic, for citation in explanations (not a raw text dump).

tools.name: shortest_path_between_cards
tools.description: Shortest path between two cards over the shared-device/email/region backbone, for 'how are these two suspicious accounts connected' questions.

tools.name: write_case_to_graph
tools.description: Case write-back / case-memory job. Upserts an InvestigationCase vertex with all evidence/policy/typology/action edges, and computes SIMILAR_TO edges to related past cases (both ClosedCase and other InvestigationCase). This is the call that satisfies 'each case also written into the graph.'

input.case: object — the full `case` part of the answer-file schema (status, verdict, fraud_probability, pattern, pattern_description, affected_txn_ids, first_suspicious_txn_id, connected_card_ids, connected_device_profiles, exposure_usd, evidence[], similar_prior_cases[], summary)
